title: Understanding model probabilities
text: AD means Alzheimer's disease and CN means cognitively normal. The displayed numbers are model scores for these two classes. A high score is not proof of disease, a clinical risk estimate, or proof that the uploaded image is a valid MRI. This research model cannot diagnose an individual.

title: How slices become a patient result
text: The deployed model scores each accepted slice separately and averages its class probabilities. The evaluation used 32 slices per subject. A single slice or an incomplete scan does not reproduce that input setting. Patient folders must contain only one person's scan; folder names do not verify identity.

title: Reading Grad-CAM
text: Grad-CAM highlights model sensitivity for a predicted class on one representative slice. It is not a segmentation of damaged tissue and does not establish that the model uses disease-specific anatomy. The displayed map is Grad-CAM, not LIME or learned slice attention.

title: Learned slice attention
text: The research attention head learns weights for slice features and combines them into one patient representation. Its weights sum to one within a patient. Larger weights indicate how the aggregation head combines features; they are not causal evidence or locations of confirmed disease. This experiment does not replace the deployed equal-averaging model automatically.

title: Synthetic augmentation experiment
text: The conditional DCGAN experiment generates independent synthetic slices conditioned on a requested AD or CN label. Requested labels and realistic appearance do not verify pathology. Synthetic slices are used only for an auxiliary training loss, not as invented 32-slice patients. Generators see training patients only; validation and test images remain real.
source: Conditional GAN paper and research experiment design

title: Interpreting the evaluation
text: The website's historical accuracy and macro F1 use a threshold selected on the same pooled out-of-fold predictions being scored. They are post-hoc calibration results. AUC measures ranking without this decision threshold. New research experiments select thresholds using inner validation patients only. Neither retrospective result establishes clinical readiness.

title: Local explanations and storage
text: The explanation feature runs locally and accepts only predefined questions about the project. Patient images, folder identifiers and individual results are not sent to an LLM service. The image-upload parser can use temporary disk storage; the application closes upload handles after reading. Batch results disappear when the page reloads unless exported.
